title: MultimodalRotaryEmbedding slices rotary embedding along the wrong dimension and omits cp_group when CP is enabled, so each CP rank sees the wrong rotary position embedding
trigger_conditions: MultimodalRotaryEmbedding (mrope) used in a multimodal model
Sequence dimension is dim 0 of the post-transpose tensor
root_cause: After emb.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() the sequence dimension is index 0, but get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank was called with seq_dim=1 and no cp_group argument. The wrong axis was sharded across CP ranks, and the default global cp_group fallback was used instead of the configured one. Each CP rank ended up with a rotary slice that does not correspond to its own sequence partition.
invariant: MultimodalRotaryEmbedding output for CP rank r must equal get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank(global_emb, seq_dim=0, group=cp_group) for the configured cp_group.
silent_check: Slicing along axis 1 (head dim) yields a tensor of the right rank/dtype but fewer features per token; the model still runs; only the rotary positional encoding is structurally wrong, distorting attention scores for every token.
